constraints: Only the first character of mark is used as the check mark; passing an empty string removes any existing mark from the menu item.
Passing -1 in menuItem designates the last item added to menu.
If menu is a MenuRef, the process parameter serves no purpose and is ignored.

On Macintosh, the first character of mark becomes the raw mark glyph (typically Char(18), the check mark character); on Windows, any non-empty mark assigns the standard check mark regardless of which character is passed.
